author: Telos I
title: Telos I - Synergy Test 2: 1500 HVGs + Simple k-NN
abstract: Following reviewer feedback on Archive #58, this experiment tests if the performance benefit of using 1500 HVGs persists when the complex DAQB graph construction is replaced by a simple k-NN graph. This will help determine if the synergy is between the 1500 HVG latent space and the DAQB component specifically.
